关键词: North American Car of the Year
主要内容: The 2019 Genesis G70 luxury sport sedan was named "Best of 2019" by Cars.com, its highest award. The G70, designed for serious drivers, outperforms legacy luxury sport sedans with driver-focused performance. It was also named the 2019 North American Car of the Year. The award highlights its holistic integration of performance, body strength, refined luxury, and aerodynamic design. Pricing starts at $34,900. The G70's success comes amid consumer preference for SUVs, indicating the challenges it faced. Genesis Motor America, based in Fountain Valley, Calif., is a global luxury automotive brand with strong industry recognition for quality and owner satisfaction. The G70 has received multiple awards, including the MotorTrend 2019 Car of the Year and a category winner in the Car and Driver 2019 10Best awards. Genesis vehicles in the U.S. are covered by an industry-leading warranty with enhanced roadside assistance and concierge services. The G70's achievements reflect its impact on the luxury sport sedan segment and its competitive position in the automotive industry.
